headline: Discussed a draft RFP and floor plan for the new facility, and 30 Cross Street as a possible joint police and fire training facility.
summary: The committee reviewed a draft request for proposals and a conceptual site plan, and discussed the draft floor plan. The Police and Fire Departments are looking at 30 Cross Street for a possible joint training facility. The committee also discussed a fundraiser at the Double Tree in Bristol.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 16, 2026 regular meeting, unanimously.
Approved the minutes of the August 18, 2026 special meeting, unanimously.

plain_text:
City of Bristol 
ANIMAL CONTROL BUILDING COMMITTEE 
October 15th 2026 
111 North Main Street 
Bristol, CT 06010 
 
 
PRESENT:     ABSENT:    
Lindsey Rivers, Public Works Analyst Holly Goodwin, Commissioner   
Frank Stawski, Commissioner    
Lynn DellaBianca, Commissioner 
Jon Mace, Commissioner 
Nancy Levesque, Commissioner  
Christopher Hayden, Commissioner  
Luis Lorenzo, Maintenance Technician 
 
STAFF PRESENT: 
Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor of Bristol  
 Raymond Rogozinski, Director of Public Works  
 
1. CALL TO ORDER 
Commissioner Christopher Hayden called the meeting to order at 5:00 pm.  
 
2. PUBLIC PARTICIPATION 
NONE 
 
3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES 
 
a. Regular Meeting – July 16th 2026  
Commissioner Frank Stawski made a motion to approve the meeting minutes, Seconded 
by Commissioner Luis Lorenzo 
  Vote: Unanimously Passed  
 
b. Special Meeting – August 18th 2026 
Commissioner Frank Stawski made a motion to approve the meeting minutes, Seconded 
by Commissioner Luis Lorenzo 
  Vote: Unanimously Passed  
 
4. NEW BUISNESS  
 
a. Review of Draft RFP 
 
Director of Public Works Raymond Rogozinski brief overview of the draft RFP presented 
to the committee and a conceptual site plan. He recommended the committee move 
forward with a two stage process. First requesting a request for qualifications and then
the request for proposal. Also, Raymond suggested the police department and Animal 
Control staff to review the draft RFP to ensure all components are being met.  
 
The committee had a brief discussion on the draft floor plan for the facility. They 
reviewed the parking area, kennels and bathrooms. Chairperson Lindsey Rivers told the 
committee to review the RFP and send her any questions or comments by next Friday 
October 23rd.  
 
5. OLD BUSINESS  
Mayor Ellen Zoppo-Sassu gave an update about 30 Cross Street to the committee. The 
Police Department and Fire Department are looking at the building for a potential joint 
training facility. If the two departments take over the building for the training facility 
then the bond will have to be changed from one project to another project.  
 
The committee briefly discussed having a fundraiser at the Double Tree in Bristol. Mayor 
Ellen Zoppo –Sassu reminded the committee one of the managers offered to donate us the 
space to host an event.  
 
6. ADJOURNMENT  
Commissioner Frank Stawski made a motion to adjourn, seconded by Commissioner 
Nancy Levesque  
   Vote: Unanimously Passed  
The Animal Control Building Committee regular meeting on October 15th 2026 was 
hereby adjourned at 5:26pm. 
 
Jacqueline England   
Recording Secretary
